_meta.translator_notes: Traducción para ChromaWing, un juego de cría genética de loros

coins._context: Game currency. Displayed in header stats. Max length: 15 chars.

parrots._context: Number of parrots owned. Displayed in header stats. Max length: 15 chars.

generation._context: Breeding generation number. Displayed in header stats. Max length: 15 chars.

mutations._context: Genetic mutations toggle. Displayed in header stats. Max length: 15 chars.

autoExam._context: Auto-examination feature toggle. Displayed in header stats. Max length: 15 chars.

on._context: Toggle status: enabled. Max length: 5 chars.

off._context: Toggle status: disabled. Max length: 5 chars.

buy._context: Button text to purchase a parrot in the shop. Synonym: purchase. Max length: 10 chars.

sell._context: Button text to sell a parrot. Hold-to-sell action. Max length: 10 chars.

locked._context: Status indicator that parrot is protected from selling. Max length: 15 chars.

delete._context: Button text to delete item. Max length: 10 chars.

clone._context: Button text to clone a parrot to color lab. Max length: 10 chars.

close._context: Button text to close modal or panel. Max length: 10 chars.

clearAll._context: Button text to clear all notifications. Max length: 15 chars.

notifications._context: Notification history panel header. Max length: 25 chars.

title._context: Game title on splash screen. Should NOT be translated - it's a brand name.

subtitle._context: Game subtitle on splash screen. Max length: 40 chars.

description1._context: First description line on splash screen. Max length: 80 chars.

description2.value: ¡Crea combinaciones únicas, compite en concursos y descubre mutaciones raras!
description2._context: Second description line on splash screen. Max length: 90 chars.

startPlaying._context: Primary button on splash screen to begin game. Max length: 20 chars.

feature1._context: Feature highlight on splash screen. Max length: 30 chars.

feature3._context: Feature highlight on splash screen. Max length: 30 chars.

contests._context: Tab name for beauty contests. Max length: 15 chars.

gallery._context: Tab name for parrot gallery. Max length: 15 chars.

colorLab._context: Tab name for gene editor. Max length: 15 chars.

wings._context: Body part name: wings of a bird. Displayed in genetics panel. Max length: 20 chars.

body._context: Body part name: main body/torso of bird. Max length: 20 chars.

head._context: Body part name: head of bird. Max length: 20 chars.
